build_checkpoint_manager: build a CheckpointManager that creates transparent git shadow-repo snapshots of working directories
create_shadow_repo_path: create a deterministic shadow repo path from a working directory using sha256 hash
test_checkpoint_take: test taking a checkpoint with CheckpointManager.ensure_checkpoint returns True on success
test_checkpoint_dedup: test that CheckpointManager deduplicates checkpoints within the same turn
test_checkpoint_list: test listing checkpoints sorted most-recent-first with hash and reason metadata
test_checkpoint_restore: test restoring a working directory to a previous checkpoint by commit hash
test_checkpoint_diff: test generating a diff between a checkpoint and the current working tree
test_working_dir_resolution: test resolving a file path to its project root via .git or pyproject.toml markers
test_git_env_isolation: test that _git_env isolates shadow repos from global and system git configs
test_restore_security: test that restore rejects argument injection, invalid hex hashes, and path traversal
